capabilities: Refine selected text through a floating prompt anchored to the cursor
Preview results as a word-level diff with Apply, Retry, Copy, or Discard
Route requests to cloud APIs, local model servers, or locally installed AI CLIs
Pin a specific provider and model to individual quick prompts
Dictate instructions through a Whisper-compatible transcription endpoint
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat or note-generation assistant; it only rewrites the current text selection in place.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. On Obsidian versions before 1.11.4, API and voice tokens are stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json, which a synced vault would propagate.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to apply an AI instruction to a text selection, so users must copy text out to an AI tool and paste the result back.

relations.evidence: Runs the Gemini CLI as a child process.
Runs the Codex CLI as a child process.
Ollama and OpenAI-compatible local servers (LM Studio, etc.).

requires.name: Locally installed AI CLI (Codex CLI or Gemini CLI)

summary: Selection refiner that rewrites selected text in place via a floating prompt backed by cloud APIs, local models, or AI CLIs.
